calibration.method: logistic on [logit(p_modernbert), logit(p_minicheck), logit(p_factcg)], inputs clipped to [1e-4, 1-1e-4]

fit.labels: LLM-AggreFact dev split (human labels; parameters only, no rows redistributed)
fit.sample: up to 400 rows per sub-dataset, seed 0 (4,349 rows)
fit.thresholds: fixed-sequence strict-to-loose search; 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on false-accept and false-reject rates <= 0.10; at most 3 items counted per source document
